name: Umbral Batiente
motion: Out-swing casement pair: both cam levers lift 90°, the left leaf swings out to 80°, then the right (which carries the astragal); they close in reverse order (Sash_Open).
options: Steel: Bronce Umbra, Acero Grafito, Negro Carbón, Piedra, Latón Cepillado
Handle: Bronce Umbra, Latón Cepillado, Acero Grafito, Negro Carbón
Glazing bars: through bars 35 mm 2 × 3 / 2 × 4 / 3 × 5, applied bars 22 mm 2 × 3, no bars
Glass: Claro low-E, Satinado acid-etched, Acanalado reeded

hotspots.title: Open the casements
hotspots.text: Lift the cam handles and both leaves swing out to 80°. The right leaf carries the astragal, so it closes last and seals first.

hotspots.title: Hot-rolled steel, welded
hotspots.text: Solid steel, welded at every corner. 36.5 mm where it is fixed, 66.7 mm where it opens.

hotspots.title: Insulating glass
hotspots.text: Two 6 mm lites with a 12.5 mm cavity. The spacer is finished in the frame colour.

hotspots.title: Glazing beads
hotspots.text: Square or sloped. The choice sets the shadow line the bead draws on the glass.

geometry.note: max leaf from the 1829 × 2438 size: (1829 − 2 × 25 frame) / 2 wide, casement zone to the transom bar centre high (estimate from generator parameters)

stills.finish: Bronce Umbra steel, Latón Cepillado handles

gaps: Hotspot pins show on the default size only; the shopper's dimension readout uses the whole GLB box (all three sizes).
No sidelites; one panel configuration (pair + transom).
Through bars are modelled as caps on both faces over continuous glass (not individually glazed panes).
Latón Cepillado on the steel uses the bronze grain maps (suggested option).
